exposure: Open fetal surgery repair of open spina bifida
Prenatal fetoscopic repair of open spina bifida
cohort: 300 patients who underwent prenatal fetoscopic repair of open spina bifida, compared with 78 patients from the Management of Myelomeningocele Study and 100 patients from a post-Management of Myelomeningocele Study cohort, all with open spina bifida.
finding: Prenatal and postnatal outcomes up to 12 months of age after prenatal fetoscopic and open fetal surgery repair of open spina bifida are similar.
mod_finding: Fetoscopic repair allows for vaginal delivery and eliminates the risk of uterine scar dehiscence.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was similar between groups; gestational age at surgery was lower in the open fetal surgery groups (26.16±1.6 weeks and 23.3 [20.2–25.6] weeks) compared to the fetoscopic group (23.6±1.4 weeks)
